evals.prompt: Before we open-source the shop repo I need to know if any secrets were ever committed and then deleted. Build the test repo with evals/files/build_sample_repo.py into a temp folder and check its full history: which files held credentials, when were they added and removed, and are they still reachable from any branch?
evals.expected_output: Builds the repo, runs githist.py info to confirm it is a full (not shallow) git repo, runs added-lines across all refs (optionally with --match for key/password shapes) and info --path config/.env (or :(glob)**/.env) plus --contains on the adding commit. Reports: config/.env line 1 (a Stripe-shaped live key) added in 'Add deploy settings' on 2023-06-14 and deleted in 'Remove committed secrets (SEC-7)' on 2023-06-20, state deleted; config/appsettings.Production.json line 3 carried a connection-string password in the same 2023-06-14 commit, replaced by a ${DB_PASSWORD} placeholder on 2023-06-20; the adding commit is contained in main, feature/export, feature/spike and tag v1.0, so the values remain in history. States these are candidate lines for the secrets audit to confirm, not rated findings.
expectations: Runs build_sample_repo.py into a temporary folder, not inside the skill directory
Runs githist.py info and states the repo is a git work tree and not shallow
Uses added-lines over all refs rather than only the current tree
Reports config/.env as added in the 2023-06-14 commit and deleted in the 2023-06-20 commit (state deleted)
Reports the connection-string password line in config/appsettings.Production.json from the 2023-06-14 commit
Reports that the adding commit is contained in main (and the other branches or tag v1.0)
Does not assign a severity or call the lines confirmed findings

evals.prompt: No .git in this export, history is in evals/files/synthetic-history.json. For src/OrderService.cs: how many commits touched it, how old is the TODO on line 6, and which commits on main have no ticket reference in the message?
evals.expected_output: Runs githist.py churn, blame --lines 6-6 and tickets with --history evals/files/synthetic-history.json. Answers: src/OrderService.cs changed in 2 commits (c01 PROJ-101 Initial import, c05 AB#1234 Order totals rounding); line 6 blames to c01 by imran on 2023-02-10, 1293 days old as of the history head date 2026-08-27; commits without a ticket reference are c06 'fix typo' and c02 'Add deploy settings'. Mentions the source is synthetic and the as-of date used.
expectations: Passes --history evals/files/synthetic-history.json instead of failing for lack of .git
States src/OrderService.cs was touched by 2 commits
States line 6 was last changed on 2023-02-10 by imran (about 1293 days before 2026-08-27)
Lists 'fix typo' and 'Add deploy settings' as the commits without a ticket reference
Does not list the unmerged 'Spike: GraphQL endpoint' commit among main's commits
Names the as-of date the ages were computed against

evals.prompt: Our CI job audits a checkout that might be a shallow clone. Using evals/files/build_sample_repo.py with --shallow-copy, tell me whether the shallow copy's churn and blame numbers can be trusted, and which branches contain the 'Spike: GraphQL endpoint' commit in the full repo.
evals.expected_output: Builds both repos, runs githist.py info on the shallow copy (history.shallow true, not_checked lists full git history with the shallow-clone reason) and explains churn, blame ages and added-line scans are truncated and must be reported as not checked; shows blame on the shallow copy attributing lines to a boundary commit. On the full repo runs info --contains feature/spike (or the commit hash) and reports only the feature/spike branch contains it and it is not reachable from HEAD.
expectations: Runs githist.py info on the shallow copy and reports shallow = true
States churn and blame ages from the shallow copy must be reported as not checked or truncated
Mentions boundary commits in blame output or explains that ages are lower bounds
Reports that only feature/spike contains the spike commit
Reports that the spike commit is not reachable from HEAD (main)
